title: Determine Whether Two Positive Integer Numbers Are Coprime

entrypoints.name: coprime
entrypoints.postcondition: Returns true if and only if the mathematical greatest common divisor of a and b equals 1.
entrypoints.outside_precondition: The authoritative statement specifies no behavior for zero or negative arguments.

trusted_components_policy: No helper algorithm, GCD oracle, or final decision procedure is admitted as a trusted runtime component. The test-only oracle in test_generated.ml is not synthesis input and is not a runtime declaration.
determinism: Required: pure and deterministic on the positive-input domain.
